name: Delhi & NCR
summary: Delhi, NCR cities and the surrounding region · offline streets and driving routes
source: OpenStreetMap contributors · Geofabrik Northern, Central and Western Zones
limitations: Wide geographic envelope around NCR, not an administrative boundary. OSM completeness varies. Public residential and service roads are routable; private roads are excluded. About 3 m drawing / 5 m routing simplification. No turn restrictions, live closures or safety-validated directions. The Shahdara preview is an area point, not a verified Kirti Mandir entrance; live journeys start from GPS.
